ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Withholding of Evidence
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's withholding of evidence in shootings by federal officers during an ICE surge.
questions: What evidence is the Trump administration withholding?
Why is the Trump administration withholding this evidence?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale cover-up by the Trump administration. By following the money and examining public records, we may be able to uncover the truth behind the withholding of evidence.
